## UI proof

A change that users can see (Settings, the arrow, a notice, a menu, any new or changed text) needs screenshots or a short recording from a build of this branch. Show light and dark appearance where the look changes, and one non-English locale where text changes.

Put the images in this description, or commit them as PNG files under `docs/verification/<short-name>/`.

A new string goes into every locale in the same commit. The test `LocaleCoverageTests` enforces it.

Tick exactly one:

- [ ] This PR changes something users see, and the proof is above
- [ ] This PR changes nothing users see
